content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Savannah

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's current eligibility criteria—education level, years of project experience, and contact-hour prerequisites—to confirm you meet the baseline. Gather your project records and work history before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® training course. Attend all sessions from your Savannah location on a flexible schedule that fits your work and personal commitments. Our active certified practitioners guide you through the PMBOK® framework, exam domains, and real-world application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register directly with PMI and document your eligibility claims. Pay the PMI examination fee and complete the credential application. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the submission process so your application is complete and approved before your exam window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your PMP® exam at a Pearson VUE testing center convenient to Savannah. On exam day, apply the knowledge and strategies from your training to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® runs on a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or knowledge-sharing to stay current and renew your credential. Granite PM Academy's ongoing resources help you meet renewal requirements without interruption.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
